stories.title: 2 hospitalized after multi-vehicle crash on highway near Alamodome, SAFD says
stories.summary: The crash happened in the northbound lanes of Interstate 37 near the Alamodome around 4:00 p.m. Sunday.

stories.title: Nearly 200-year-old Texas bowling tradition is still knocking down pins around San Antonio
stories.summary: Unlike traditional 10-pin bowling, nine-pin is built around teamwork. The game was brought to the region by German immigrants who began settling in Texas in 1831.

stories.title: 'A living legacy' | The Gunter Hotel marks 90 years since a legendary moment in blues music history
stories.summary: Ninety years after Robert Johnson helped pave the path for blues and rock & roll in downtown San Antonio, his grandson returned to continue the legacy.

stories.title: 'She will be deeply missed.' | Southside ISD remembers officer killed in crash Sunday in far south Bexar County
stories.summary: Deputies say there were two witnesses who said one of the vehicles was making a u-turn when the crash happened.

stories.title: Texas leads in traffic fatalities in first half of year despite small nationwide drop, NHTSA report says
stories.summary: The report charts fatalities for the first half of 2026. Texas’ fatality rate fell by five compared to the first half of last year.

stories.title: Flames engulf reportedly vacant home on San Antonio’s south side
stories.summary: Crews brought the McKinley Avenue fire under control in about 30 minutes Saturday night. No injuries were reported.

stories.title: Isaiah Johnson scores 26 points to help No. 7 Texas hold off Baylor in San Antonio
stories.summary: No. 7 Texas remains unbeaten as Isaiah Johnson had a season-high 26 points.

stories.title: Southside ISD officer killed in far south Bexar County two-vehicle crash, district says
stories.summary: Two other adults were involved in the two-vehicle crash Sunday.

stories.title: Where is Bob? Injured buck’s disappearance prompts Selma resident’s call for action
stories.summary: Linda Weniger says a familiar 10-point buck disappeared after suffering an arrow wound. She wants neighbors to seek no-hunting signs.

stories.title: Found: 15-year-old who was missing on far west side
stories.summary: The girl has been located and is safe.

stories.title: Two people found shot to death after disturbance call in Schertz
stories.summary: Police found a 35-year-old woman and a 40-year-old man with apparent gunshot wounds early Sunday. Investigators believe the incident was isolated.

stories.title: San Antonio man accused of repeatedly kicking, dragging dog in abuse caught on doorbell camera
stories.summary: Police say the dog was covered in scars, injuries and patches of missing fur. A veterinary exam revealed evidence of ongoing abuse.
